description: This file defines the JMSMultiExternalEventProducer class, which implements external event production via JMS in a Fineract-based project. It manages connection handling, message partitioning, and asynchronous message sending to multiple producers.

classes.name: JMSMultiExternalEventProducer
classes.description: A Spring component that produces external JMS events, managing connection pooling, message partitioning, and asynchronous dispatch.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Public method to send a batch of event partitions asynchronously, with performance measurement and logging.

methods.name: closeSessions
methods.description: Closes all JMS sessions, logging errors if any occur.

methods.name: obtainProducers
methods.description: Creates JMS sessions and message producers based on configured producer count, returning paired sessions and producers.

methods.name: sendPartitions
methods.description: Creates asynchronous tasks to send message partitions through respective producers.

methods.name: createSendingTask
methods.description: Creates an async task to send a list of messages via a given JMS message producer.

methods.name: mapPartitionsToProducers
methods.description: Distributes message partitions among producers based on consistent hashing.

methods.name: waitForSendingCompletion
methods.description: Waits synchronously for all asynchronous send tasks to complete.
